correctness.rationale: The embedded checker reconstructs all 28 Fano-nonline vertices, 42 disjointness edges and all pairwise graph distances. It exhaustively checks 112 elementary scale-two collapses fixing the graph and 10896 scale-three simplices with a complete 5404-pair acyclic discrete-Morse matching: one critical vertex, 87 critical four-cells, no other critical cells. Full directed Hasse graph topological sort is exhaustive. Forman theory proves the integral wedge. Diameter four and inclusion-preserving collapses prove all barcode endpoints; no extrapolation or numerical approximation is used.

value.rationale: The Coxeter graph is the natural canonical 28-vertex cubic distance-transitive graph of girth seven, whose graph-distance Vietoris–Rips filtration is a genuine topological invariant of interest beyond classical Platonic examples. The radius-three classification is an unexpected 87-fold four-sphere wedge, versus 15 persistent circles at radii one and two; the full integral barcode and scale-one-to-two inclusion map are determined. The result is an exact natural complete classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice, textbook deduction, or unsupported numerical curiosity.
